The '''Kade brothers''' were three [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Humans]] who worked for [[Oridelve Incorporated]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gavos]]. They, along with [[Darvis]], were gunned down and killed in the mining complex canteen during the [[Gavos Droid Revolution]].
